author: MiYu
scope: Derive visible stationary units once per HUD draw for scenery and grass distance tests. Rebuild on every render; no cache survives a draw or hides direct state changes.

fullWorldEquivalence.author: MiYu
fullWorldEquivalence.scope: Three map families, four viewport shapes, retained frames, live editor geometry/water/surface/doodad/tileset edits, animated water clocks, fog reveal/hide, menu/editor/game reactivation and native-normalized component values.

stationaryUnitAndFogEquivalence.author: MiYu
stationaryUnitAndFogEquivalence.scope: Full native-normalized client worlds over three maps: 128 mobile units, stationary blockers moving across the exact radius, enemy fog hide/reveal, removal/recreation, dead blockers and editor/menu/game transitions. Visibility call counts include all client phases. Excludes native rendering, assets and IPC.

before.scope: Actual native QuickJS client with the full authored world and native incremental update path; 50 measured frames after 5 warmups. JS phases use millisecond wall-clock timestamps. Native API wrapper times are included in phases. Excludes renderer and IPC; step includes snapshot deltas and profiling storage.

after.scope: Actual native QuickJS client with the full authored world and native incremental update path; 50 measured frames after 5 warmups. JS phases use millisecond wall-clock timestamps. Native API wrapper times are included in phases. Excludes renderer and IPC; step includes snapshot deltas and profiling storage.

native.releaseRebuildReason: Only external game script and QA harness changed; Editor and Rust sources match the previously validated packaged binary.

qaStages.name: native Toggle InputField and restart session

comparison.scope: Separate native runs using the identical editor, scene, render size and submitted counts, with changed game script proven equivalent by 126 complete normalized world comparisons. FPS remains below smooth gameplay; isolated QuickJS differences are not a causal FPS claim.

remainingPerformanceEvidence.note: Live reference comparison remains unchanged and must continue to preserve direct edits.
